comment: Teacher connects y²/x²/xy to side lengths and area and later simplifies x² + y² + 3x², but some explanations remain informal and depend on unseen tile gestures.
Lesson moves from identifying tiles to equation/expression mats and then simplifying like terms, with peer support for less experienced students.
Teacher asks multiple checks and invites student explanations, but several confusions are handled quickly and individual understanding is not fully documented.
Teacher repeatedly asks why/how questions about tile meanings, side lengths, positive/negative tiles, and whether the task is solving or simplifying.
Useful real lesson but leaves opportunities to explicitly formalize variable/area reasoning, colour conventions, and the solve-vs-simplify distinction.
